dog.description_text: Meet Maple! Maple is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDtmFMsyHvsSKMT_KKRwtwUAb43r2UibYh1gzBCcdGC4J4 Maple is a 10 month old female mixed breed dog. She has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. She is friendly and playful. Her fosters say she likes to cuddle. She is very energetic and sweet. She is working on house training. She is eager to please. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
